text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 16 · 复古旅行海报 · 环形星球的度假发射港 · 番茄红 / 湖蓝 / 奶黄.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Optimistic retro-futurist screenprint travel-poster artwork, empty lakeside spaceport and elegant slim rocket on a launch pad, low curved terminal, huge ringed planet above distant hills, tomato-red structures against turquoise lake and creamy yellow sky, limited inks and tasteful print grain, no words or branding.
Visual medium: retro poster; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 16 · 复古旅行海报 · 环形星球的度假发射港 · 番茄红 / 湖蓝 / 奶黄. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions. IMPORTANT: Reference 2 ORIGINAL image determines artistic medium and color grading: layered paper sculpture, Chinese ink watercolor, retro travel poster, vintage film or dreamy 3D, as applicable. Reference 1 only determines spatial layout. Preserve original palette and artistic medium. No dimension values or scale bars.
